@patch('subprocess.run')
    def test_pacman_get_packages(self, mock_run):
        """Test Pacman package listing."""
        mock_run.return_value = MagicMock(
            stdout="google-chrome 91.0.4472.77-1\nfirefox 89.0-1\n",
            returncode=0
        )
        
        manager = PacmanManager()
        packages = manager.get_installed_packages()
        
        self.assertEqual(len(packages), 2)
        self.assertEqual(packages[0]["name"], "google-chrome")
        self.assertEqual(packages[0]["version"], "91.0.4472.77-1")
        self.assertEqual(packages[0]["manager"], "pacman")
